text: Starting the reporting layer for the Grocery App dashboard. Thinking MongoDB — flexible schema, quick to set up. Any objections?
Wait. We rejected MongoDB for reporting on the Retail Corp CRM project. Loyalty reports took 40+ seconds. See ADR-004.
I didn't know about that. Where is it?
adr_004_postgresql_reporting.md. We went with PostgreSQL materialized views and reports load in about 3 seconds.
Lesson from that one: benchmark reporting queries with real data volume before choosing a store.
OK, switching to PostgreSQL. I'll benchmark with 5M rows first.
Quick one — a regional bank prospect asks if we've done Kubernetes in finance. Who should I loop in?
That's me. Bank A: EKS, 12 weeks, delivered July 2024. I can join the call.
Great, Thursday 3pm. Can I share the anonymized case study?
Yes, the Kubernetes bank case study is cleared for public use. Don't share the Bank A proposal or pricing.
FYI, I finished the runbook for the Redis session queue issue at Retail Corp. Kavita, can you review?
Reminder: the legacy performance benchmark in week 1 is now mandatory for all compliance projects (from the GDPR post-mortem).
Added it to the delivery template.
Do we have a price reference for a 10-week ML project?
Grocery App recommendation engine: $85,000 for 10 weeks. It's in the proposals folder.
